notes: 2026-10-08 review pass by subagent: All 5 acceptance lines proven by tests that pass: ui-unit 11/11, kit+a11y e2e 8/8. (1) kit.spec.ts:47-66 checks the 9 h2 headings by exact name and meta robots noindex (layout.tsx metadata robots index:false). (2) kit.spec.ts:68 requests the production build on PUBLIC_URL without KIT_ENABLED and gets 404 (layout.tsx calls notFound(), force-dynamic). (3) payments.test.tsx Money test: text is '1,234.56 USDC' and the figures span has tabular-nums; formatTokenAmount is pure bigint, no Number/parseFloat/toFixed anywhere in ui-web or kit. (4) Address test: shows 0x1234…5678, the copy click calls clipboard.writeText with the full address, and the label changes to 'Address copied'; StatusPill test: 10 statuses, labels match PAYMENT_STATUSES and are all distinct. (5) a11y.spec.ts: axe finds 0 serious/critical issues in light and dark. Correctness: explorer link has target=_blank rel='noreferrer noopener'; QrCode encodes real data with uqr and is pinned to data-theme=light, so it shows dark modules on a light ground in both themes (confirmed in kit-dark.png); Tabs and Tooltip use Radix (arrow keys, opens on focus); Dialog uses native showModal (Esc, focus trap) with a labelled close button; TextField sets aria-invalid and aria-describedby for the error or hint; EmailCapture uses an sr-only label, aria-invalid and an aria-live message. Rules: types live in src/types/{ui,payments,kit}; finite values are as-const constants with derived unions; components use token utilities only (no raw hex, no default palette); payment sample data is labelled. Screenshots: all states are visible and contrast is fine in light and dark; the 390px layout does not break (kit nav and code block scroll inside their own boxes). Non-blocking: (a) payments-showcase.tsx repeats token='USDC' and decimals={6} about 11 times, and its timeline step labels repeat SAMPLE_STEPS and PAYMENT_STATUSES labels; move them to constants (SAMPLE_INVOICE.token exists). (b) The Toast tone dot uses the soft tone background (display.tsx:128), so it is almost invisible, especially in dark. (c) useCopy (interactive.tsx:1464) has no catch for a clipboard rejection and does not clear its timer on unmount; the 1600ms timeout and Tooltip delayDuration=200 are raw durations, not tokens. (d) Dialog backdrop uses the default Tailwind backdrop-blur-sm, not --fw-blur-glass. (e) The a11y dark test runs axe right after setting data-theme while body colors transition over 240ms; to be safe, wait for the transition or emulate reduced motion. (f) The anchor slug logic is duplicated in page.tsx:93 and kit-section.tsx:159. (g) QR quiet zone is border 2 plus padding, under the 4 modules the spec recommends; scanners usually accept it. (h) The kit's sample copy ('Arbitrum (planned)', the invented forwend.invoices.create API in CodeBlock) is fine on a private noindex page, but do not reuse it on the landing page in F006-F008.
